text.title: Threshold Choice
text.body: Far beneath the sundered bailey lies the Threshold Chamber of the Crown Vault, where volcanic fire and frozen stillness hang in silent balance. Defeat the Threshold Wardens and Honor Guard, then step onto either the West Altar of Order or the East Altar of Ember to decide Thornvael's destiny.
text.obj.0: Defeat the Threshold Wardens and Honor Guard
text.obj.1: Step onto the West Altar (Order) or East Altar (Ember)
text.msg.1: The fleets are safe, Commander, yet the continent's heart still screams beneath us. To the west stands the Altar of Order, where Korrath waits in petrified stasis; to the east burns the Furnace Heart of Vorak. Defeat the Threshold Wardens and step onto your chosen stone—there is no turning back.
text.msg.2: The Threshold Chamber is quiet. Step onto the West Altar for Crown of Order, or the East Altar for Ember Reckoning—this step cannot be undone.
text.msg.3: Pale crystalline blue light answers your step—the frozen marble stair down to the Crown Vault unseals!
text.msg.4: Volcanic crimson flame surges beneath your boots—the obsidian descent into the Furnace Heart opens!
text.win: The Threshold is crossed and Thornvael's final reckoning awaits.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell inside the Threshold Chamber.
